Chapter 522: Chapter 16: Crystal Of Chaos (Please Subscribe)_2

Chapter 522: Chapter 16: Crystal of Chaos (Please Subscribe)_2

After all, facing a massive gap in the number of Eighth Layer invincibles, only Ninth Rank, Tenth Rank Secret Treasures, have hope of bridging it.

“If human civilization can utilize high-level secret treasures, why can’t the Tianyu Clan?” The Six-Winged Elder said indifferently.

“Second, the human side has invited a group of invincible Eighth Layer to help out, but they’re all lying in ambush.”

The Five-winged Tianyu Clan Strongman continued.

“It’s meaningless.” The Six-Winged Elder’s tone was calm.

In the face of absolute strength, there’s no such thing as sneaking or ambushing.

...

“Third…”

The Five-winged Tianyu Clan Strongman paused, then slowly said, “The Galaxy Master might have been invited and come to this battlefield.”

Upon hearing this,

The Six-Winged Elder’s expression became slightly heavier.

Even he had heard of the Galaxy Master’s prestige.

After all, this was the one who had broken the myth of invincible Eighth Layer beings by killing two Eighth Layer invincibles with his bare hands, without relying on any ‘external force.’

Although those two Eighth Layer invincibles did not come from Peak Clans, an invincible Eighth Layer is still an invincible Eighth Layer.

Speaking honestly, with his strength, the Six-Winged Elder could suppress an Eighth Layer invincible without a problem, but to kill one would require a high-level secret treasure.

“The Galaxy Master… indeed poses a problem,”

The Six-Winged Elder pondered, “But it won’t affect the overall situation. At most, he will restrain some of our clan’s invincible Eighth Layer beings.”

Considering the Galaxy Master had never exposed his strength and a sudden attack on them would indeed result in the death of some Tianyu Clan Eighth Layer beings.

But now, they were prepared for the Galaxy Master’s strength, aware of his ability to kill invincible Eighth Layer beings. With such precautions, there were unlikely to be significant losses.

At worst, they wouldn’t confront the Galaxy Master head-on but just tie him down. As long as human civilization as a whole is crushed, the Galaxy Master won’t be able to make any waves.

…

Below the thirty-thousand-meter-long Eternal Spatial Rift.

Lin Yuan’s Taiyang Divine Spirit suddenly opened his eyes.

“Two years’ time, five strands of World-Breaking Origin Force, this time it was really the right move.”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face, and this Eternal Spatial Rift on Battlefield B0001, whence the origin force of a myriad worlds accumulated, reached a point where one strand could be gathered in just a hundred and fifty days.

Basically, one complete strand of World-Breaking Origin Force could be accumulated in less than half a year.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan glanced at the distance.

He saw a strand of Power of Taiyin converging, forming a figure.

It was Lin Yuan’s Taiyin Primordial Spirit.

Having confirmed that the efficiency of this battlefield’s Eternal Spatial Rift in amplifying the accumulation of World-Breaking Origin Force was superior to the Medium-Sized Otherworldly Battlefield where the Taiyin Primordial Spirit resided,

Lin Yuan had the Taiyin Primordial Spirit leave the other battlefield and instead head to Battlefield B0001 to converge with the Taiyang Divine Spirit.

Regardless of how many Eternal Spatial Rifts Lin Yuan was under at the same time, the absorption and accumulation of World-Breaking Origin Force would be as if there were only one rift effective.

“To ensure absolute certainty, merging the two divine spirits into one to form the Taiji Primordial Spirit should be about right,”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, given that he had agreed to help Baiyun Lord against the Tianyu Clan Strongman, he naturally had to be cautious,

Even though the Taiji Primordial Spirit, which fused Taiyin and Taiyang, was still not as powerful as his true body.

Yet, it still surpassed those at the initial Ninth Rank. After mastering Complete Space Rules, Lin Yuan’s strength had increased significantly, which applied to both divine spirits as well.

Complete Space Rules, along with dozens of Cosmic Forces, meant that facing other invincible Eighth Layer beings was practically a dimensional strike.

“These two years, I’ve been delving into the Fusion Rules, the fusion of Space Rules, Taiji Rule, and other Cosmic Forces, which has also made considerable progress, fully capable of utilizing the new powers after the Fusion Rules…”

Lin Yuan thought silently.

There are two benefits to this approach.

First, the power formed after the fusion of rules, even if not completely fused yet, is far superior to any single method.

Secondly, the new power formed by the fusion of Cosmic Force and Space Rules can completely cover up the fact that Lin Yuan has realized dozens of Cosmic Forces.

At most, it will seem that Lin Yuan’s power after rule fusion is unnaturally strong.

However, in this regard, unless Lin Yuan is captured and dissected for research, no useful conclusions can be drawn.

“Has the war not yet commenced?”

Lin Yuan glanced at the central area of the battlefield, where human civilization and the Tianyu Clan were in a standoff.

“It’s almost time to make a move.”

Lin Yuan got up, knowing that translocation and teleportation were difficult on the battlefields of different races, so it was best to arrive as early as possible.

As for the delay in absorbing World-Breaking Origin Force? He didn’t care about this bit of time.

As long as the Tianyu Clan was dealt with smoothly, Lin Yuan would have plenty of time to absorb the World-Breaking Origin Force here.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

In front of him, a crystal clear, irregular fragment hovered.

If an Eighth Layer Evolver, or even a Ninth Rank Evolver, were here, they would notice that within this sparkling fragment, traces of various rules flickered and flowed.

The powers of various rules flashed by and then fused together perfectly before separating again, cycling endlessly in this manner.

“This Chaos Crystal is truly too marvelous, how can it so perfectly fuse such diverse forces of rules…”

Lin Yuan was enraptured.

The Chaos Crystal was indeed the name of this crystal clear, irregular crystal.

It was also the treasure Lin Yuan had carefully selected from the reward vault unlocked by Stone Statue Shen Ji after he passed through the second floor of the Black Tower.

This Chaos Crystal originated from the accidental discovery by the Moyu Tower Master while passing through a mysterious place in bygone years.

That place was always in a state of chaos, with countless rules continuously fusing and separating within it.

Inside the Chaos Crystal, a scene closely mirroring that mysterious place was recreated—wood, fire, earth, metal, water, the Five Elements, light, thunder, cold, life, space, and even time; the various rules occasionally merged and occasionally split.

After observing the rewards of the second and third levels for a long time, Lin Yuan finally selected this Chaos Crystal following the suggestion of Statue Shen Ji.

Because observing and understanding this Chaos Crystal greatly guided Lin Yuan in his upcoming fusion of the Taiji Rule and various cosmic forces into the Space Rules.

Ordinary Evolvers, not to mention Eighth and Ninth Layer Evolvers, would find it extremely difficult to glean much from this Chaos Crystal.

But Lin Yuan possessed Against-Heaven’s Understanding, and the effect of this Chaos Crystal on him was far beyond imagination.

In just two short years, Lin Yuan had progressed from the very beginning of his fusion process, one-tenth complete, to now half complete.

All thanks to this Chaos Crystal.

After all, in the Spirit Realm, it took Lin Yuan hundreds of years just to complete the initial one-tenth stage of the fusion process.

[Your Against-Heaven’s Understanding allows you to observe and contemplate the mysterious crystal, deepening your insight into the Fusion Rules…]

…

[Your Against-Heaven’s Understanding allows you to observe and contemplate the mysterious crystal, deepening your insight into the Fusion Rules…]

…

[Your Against-Heaven’s Understanding allows you to observe and contemplate the mysterious crystal, deepening your insight into the Fusion Rules…]

…

Lin Yuan devoted most of his mental and spiritual energy to contemplating the Chaos Crystal.

Choosing this Chaos Crystal, aside from it being a guide for his own rule fusion, was more importantly because Lin Yuan sensed that even if he stepped into the Ninth or Tenth Rank in the future, this Chaos Crystal would still have a significant effect.

After all, the Chaos Crystal’s integration of numerous rules went far beyond just the Space Rules and many common rules; it included the Rule of Life and even the Rule of Time.

The Rule of Time; that was a foundational rule only expected to be mastered by Tenth Rank and even Eleventh Rank Powerhouses.

With the Rule of Time, even without reaching the level of a Supreme Being, one could achieve, in a certain sense, infinite lifespan.

“It’s marvelous.”

“So this is the change that occurs after integrating the Space Rules,” Lin Yuan raised his right hand and strands of space force intertwined with Taiji force, eventually merging slowly together.

But when the fusion was halfway complete, it suddenly shattered and reformed into space force and Taiji force.

However, Lin Yuan was not disappointed; through this brief fusion, he had eliminated any bottlenecks on his path ahead.

“There are other cosmic forces as well.”

Lin Yuan was about to try them one by one.

Suddenly.

At that moment.

Lin Yuan’s expression shifted slightly.

“Huh!”

Lin Yuan looked up in a certain direction.
